From 8f7e917907385e112a845d668ae2832f41e64bf5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Nuno Sa <nuno.sa@analog.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jan 2024 16:14:22 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] of: property: fix typo in io-channels

The property is io-channels and not io-channel. This was effectively
preventing the devlink creation.

Fixes: 8e12257dead7 ("of: property: Add device link support for iommus, mboxes and io-channels")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Nuno Sa <nuno.sa@analog.com>
Reviewed-by: Saravana Kannan <saravanak@google.com>
Acked-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240123-iio-backend-v7-1-1bff236b8693@analog.com
Signed-off-by: Rob Herring <robh@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/of/property.c b/drivers/of/property.c
index 641a40cf5cf3..bbf0dee2fb9c 100644
--- a/drivers/of/property.c
+++ b/drivers/of/property.c
@@ -1244,7 +1244,7 @@ DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(clocks, "clocks", "#clock-cells")
 DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(interconnects, "interconnects", "#interconnect-cells")
 DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(iommus, "iommus", "#iommu-cells")
 DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(mboxes, "mboxes", "#mbox-cells")
-DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(io_channels, "io-channel", "#io-channel-cells")
+DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(io_channels, "io-channels", "#io-channel-cells")
 DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(interrupt_parent, "interrupt-parent", NULL)
 DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(dmas, "dmas", "#dma-cells")
 DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(power_domains, "power-domains", "#power-domain-cells")
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/of/property.c`**
   - The line defining the property for I/O channels was modified:
     - Changed from `DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(io_channels, "io-channel", "#io-channel-cells")` 
     - To `DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(io_channels, "io-channels", "#io-channel-cells")`
   - This change corrects a typo in the property name from "io-channel" to "io-channels".

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `drivers/of/property.c` addresses a bug that was preventing the creation of device links due to the incorrect property name. The fix ensures that the property name matches the expected format, which is crucial for the proper functioning of the device link support introduced in a previous commit (8e12257dead7). This relationship highlights that the typo was a direct cause of the issue, and correcting it resolves the bug related to device link creation.

Here is the commit message:
of: property: fix typo in io-channels

The property is io-channels and not io-channel. This was effectively
preventing the devlink creation.

Fixes: 8e12257dead7 ("of: property: Add device link support for iommus, mboxes and io-channels")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Nuno Sa <nuno.sa@analog.com>
Reviewed-by: Saravana Kannan <saravanak@google.com>
Acked-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240123-iio-backend-v7-1-1bff236b8693@analog.com
Signed-off-by: Rob Herring <robh@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by a typo in the property name for I/O channels, where "io-channel" was incorrectly used instead of the correct term "io-channels". This mismatch prevented the proper recognition and handling of the property, leading to failures in device link creation.

Here is the patch:
 DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(iommus, "iommus", "#iommu-cells")
 DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(mboxes, "mboxes", "#mbox-cells")
-DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(io_channels, "io-channel", "#io-channel-cells")
+DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(io_channels, "io-channels", "#io-channel-cells")
 DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(interrupt_parent, "interrupt-parent", NULL)
 DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(dmas, "dmas", "#dma-cells")

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(io_channels, "io-channel", "#io-channel-cells")
```
Reason:
The use of "io-channel" instead of the correct "io-channels" caused a mismatch in property recognition, preventing the system from properly handling the I/O channels, which in turn led to failures in device link creation.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+DEFINE_SIMPLE_PROP(io_channels, "io-channels", "#io-channel-cells")
```
Reason:
Changing "io-channel" to "io-channels" corrects the property name, allowing the system to properly recognize and handle the I/O channels, thus enabling successful device link creation.
